act_name: West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ordinance II of 1962)
title: Classes of Civil Courts
verbatim_text: There shall be the following classes of Civil Courts: (a) The Court of the District Judge; (b) The Court of the Additional District Judge; and (c) The Court of the Civil Judge (Class I, Class II, and Class III).
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ordinance II of 1962)

act_name: West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ordinance II of 1962)
title: Appeals from Civil Judges to District Court
verbatim_text: Save as otherwise provided by any enactment, an appeal from a decree or order of a Civil Judge shall lie: (a) to the District Judge where the value of the original suit did not exceed fifty million rupees; and (b) to the High Court in any other case.
source_citation: Official Gazette of Pakistan / Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk), West Pakistan Civil Courts Ordinance, 1962 (W.P. Ordinance II of 1962)
